question: Should OpenClaw accept LongCat as an official external provider package with first-class onboarding, catalog, docs, and release metadata?
rationale: The provider SDK can support LongCat, but adding a new official provider identity, auth choice, env var, CLI flag, package, and catalog entry is a maintainer product and release-ownership decision.

options.title: Accept Official External Provider
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100501 after maintainer review of provider ownership, package metadata, and optional authenticated smoke proof.

options.title: Keep Custom Provider Path
options.body: Defer first-class OpenClaw support and rely on LongCat's documented custom models.providers configuration until ownership or demand is clearer.

options.title: Require Live Completion Proof First
options.body: Hold acceptance until a maintainer-safe LongCat key proves an end-to-end LongCat-2.0 completion run.

recommendation.title: Accept Official External Provider
recommendation.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100501 after maintainer review of provider ownership, package metadata, and optional authenticated smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own this issue and the linked implementation candidate, and have the strongest recent provider externalization history for this feature.
